This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by 
 Y1 in the titled block.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, 
 ... etc.

items: Current transformer must be isolated and proper grounding is required

Wear your safety 
 belt because there is a danger of falling off the top of the CT stack when cleaning
 insulators or checking connections.

Presence the safety 
 supervisor is required.

sections.text: Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc

items:
Tool set for tightness, 
 Fiberglass ladder, Silicagel
Cleaning tools as cloth, rags .... etc
Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc
Voltage indicator.

In addition to the 2 monthly inspection check list, carry
 out the following steps:
Check out the condition of the expansion diaphragm

Open secondary terminal compartment, blow out compartment
 and check the condition of the weather seal

Check that all wiring terminations are tight and securely
 fastened

Check the condition of cables or conduits entering the
 secondary terminal compartment
Check earth bus connections to base of CT for tightness.
Do touch up painting if required.

SS & PS | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by 
 Y1 in the titled block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, 
 ... etc.
Current transformer must be isolated and proper grounding is required
Wear your safety 
 belt because there is a danger of falling off the top of the CT stack when cleaning
 insulators or checking connections.
Presence the safety 
 supervisor is required.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc
Tool set for tightness, 
 Fiberglass ladder, Silicagel
Cleaning tools as cloth, rags .... etc
Safety helmet, safety belt, and safety shoes ... etc
Voltage indicator.
Work to be carried out
In addition to the 2 monthly inspection check list, carry
 out the following steps:
Check out the condition of the expansion diaphragm
Open secondary terminal compartment, blow out compartment
 and check the condition of the weather seal
Check that all wiring terminations are tight and securely
 fastened
Check the condition of cables or conduits entering the
 secondary terminal compartment
Check earth bus connections to base of CT for tightness.
Do touch up painting if required.

sections_ar.text: توضح هذه الوثيقة فحص المعدات I2، الذي يجب نُفذ على سنوياً القواعد كما هو موضح بـ Y1 في titled الكتلة.
يجب إصدار أمر شغل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة،
يلزم وجود سياج أمان (حبل) مع علامات تحذير يحيط بمنطقة العمل،
ارتدِ مهمات السلامة والصحة المهنية مثل خوذة السلامة والحذاء... إلخ.

items: محول التيار يجب أن يكون معزول وسليم التأريض يلزم
ارتدِ حزام الأمان لأن هناك خطر سقوط الفصل علوي محول التيار stack عندما تنظيف العوازل أو فحص التوصيلات.
يلزم حضور مشرف السلامة.

sections_ar.text: خوذة السلامة وحزام الأمان وحذاء السلامة... إلخ

items: طقم أدوات للربط وسلم فايبر جلاس وسيليكا جل
أدوات تنظيف مثل القماش والخرق.... إلخ
خوذة السلامة وحزام الأمان وحذاء السلامة... إلخ
مبين جهد.
في إضافة إلى 2 الفحص الشهري افحص قائمة، نفذ اتباع الخطوات:
افحص خارج الحالة expansion diaphragm
افتح الثانوي الطرف الحجيرة، انفخ خارج الحجيرة وافحص الحالة weather مانع التسرب
افحص ذلك جميع الأسلاك terminations محكم وsecurely مثبت
افحص الحالة الكابلات أو conduits دخول الثانوي الطرف الحجيرة
افحص الأرض قضيب التوصيلات إلى القاعدة محول التيار لـ إحكام الربط.
Do touch لأعلى دهان إذا مطلوب.
